wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# CapCut Killer - Desktop Video Editor Overview

## Project Introduction

**CapCut Killer** is a desktop video editing application built with Electron and React, designed to provide professional video editing capabilities with offline transcription, caption styling, and multi-format export functionality. The project serves as a lightweight alternative to cloud-based video editors, focusing on local processing and privacy-conscious workflows.

### Core Goals and Objectives

- **Offline Processing**: Complete video editing workflow without internet dependency
- **Real-time Transcription**: Built-in Whisper AI-powered speech-to-text conversion
- **Professional Export**: Multiple codec support including H.264, H.265, ProRes, and VP9
- **Intuitive Timeline**: Canvas-based timeline editing with drag-and-drop functionality
- **Cross-platform Support**: Native applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux

### Target Audience

- Content creators and YouTubers seeking professional editing tools
- Social media managers requiring quick video exports
- Independent filmmakers working in offline environments
- Privacy-conscious users preferring local video processing

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern Electron architecture with clear separation between main process, renderer process, and specialized services.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Electron Main Process] --> B[IPC Handlers]
    A --> C[Services Layer]
    A --> D[Workers]
    
    B --> E[Export Handler]
    B --> F[Whisper Handler]
    B --> G[FFmpeg Handler]
    B --> H[Project Handler]
    
    C --> I[Export Queue Manager]
    C --> J[FFmpeg Service]
    C --> K[Whisper Service]
    C --> L[Thumbnail Service]
    
    D --> M[Whisper Worker]
    D --> N[Thumbnail Worker]
    
    E --> O[Renderer Store]
    F --> O
    G --> O
    
    style A fill:#4CAF50
    style C fill:#2196F3
    style D fill:#FF9800
```

### Component Breakdown

The architecture consists of four main layers:

1. **Main Process Layer**: Electron's main process handling system-level operations
2. **Service Layer**: Business logic and data processing services
3. **Worker Layer**: Background processing for heavy tasks like transcription
4. **Renderer Layer**: User interface built with React and TypeScript

### Design Patterns

- **Factory Pattern**: Used in service creation and IPC handler registration
- **Observer Pattern**: Implemented through Zustand state management and IPC event listeners
- **Strategy Pattern**: Different export strategies based on codec selection
- **Singleton Pattern**: Export queue manager ensures single point of control

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

The application starts with the Electron main process entry point:

**Main Process Entry**: `src/main/index.ts`
- Initializes Electron window with security-focused configuration
- Registers all IPC handlers for communication between processes
- Sets up development and production environment detection

**Renderer Entry Point**: `src/renderer/app/main.tsx`
- Bootstraps React application with strict mode
- Integrates DnD provider for drag-and-drop functionality
- Sets up global layout and routing structure

### Core Modules

**Export Queue Management**: `src/main/services/ExportQueue.ts`
- Implements priority queue for export jobs with concurrency control
- Handles job cancellation and progress tracking
- Manages temporary file cleanup and error recovery

**FFmpeg Service**: `src/main/services/FFmpegService.ts`
- Provides comprehensive video processing capabilities
- Supports multiple codecs and quality presets
- Includes frame extraction and media information gathering

**Whisper Service**: `src/main/services/WhisperService.ts`
- Manages AI-powered transcription in isolated worker threads
- Handles model loading and memory management
- Supports multiple languages and word-level timestamps

### Configuration Approach

**Build Configuration**: `electron.vite.config.ts`
- Vite-based build system with externalized native dependencies
- TypeScript compilation for both main and renderer processes
- PostCSS integration with Tailwind CSS

**State Management**: `src/renderer/store/`
- Zustand-based state management with Immer middleware
- Centralized export state and timeline management
- Type-safe store interfaces with automatic TypeScript inference

### External Dependencies

**Core Dependencies**:
- `@electron-toolkit/utils`: Electron development utilities
- `better-sqlite3`: Local database storage for project data
- `fluent-ffmpeg`: Video processing pipeline
- `nodejs-whisper`: AI-powered speech recognition
- `react-dnd`: Drag-and-drop functionality
- `zustand`: Lightweight state management

**Development Dependencies**:
- `electron-vite`: Modern Electron build toolchain
- `tailwindcss`: Utility-first CSS framework
- `typescript`: Type safety and development experience

### Integration Points

**IPC Communication Flow**:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant R as Renderer
    participant M as Main Process
    participant S as Services
    participant W as Workers
    
    R->>+M: export:start
    M->>+S: getExportQueue()
    S->>+W: spawnFFmpeg()
    W-->>-S: progress updates
    S-->>-M: job progress
    M-->>-R: export:progress
    
    Note over R,M: Real-time progress updates
```

**Component Relationship Diagram**:

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Page Component] --> B[Timeline]
    A --> C[Preview]
    A --> D[MediaPanel]
    A --> E[StylePanel]
    A --> F[CaptionEditor]
    A --> G[ExportDialog]
    
    B --> H[Canvas Rendering]
    C --> I[Video Player]
    D --> J[Asset Management]
    E --> K[Style Controls]
    F --> L[SRT Parser]
    G --> M[Export Queue]
    
    M --> N[FFmpeg Service]
    N --> O[Export Queue Manager]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Video Editing Interface**:
- Canvas-based timeline with zoom and pan controls
- Multi-track video and audio editing
- Drag-and-drop asset management
- Real-time preview with playhead synchronization

**Export System**:
- Multiple preset configurations for popular platforms
- Custom resolution and codec selection
- Concurrent job queuing with progress tracking
- Automatic cleanup of temporary files

**Transcription Engine**:
- Offline Whisper AI transcription
- Word-level timestamp generation
- Multi-language support
- Real-time progress indication

### Implementation Highlights

**Timeline Component**: `src/renderer/components/Timeline/index.tsx`
- Canvas-based rendering for smooth performance
- Custom drawing functions for clips and waveforms
- Advanced interaction handling for drag-and-drop
- Zoom and pan functionality with mouse wheel

**Export Dialog**: `src/renderer/components/ExportDialog/index.tsx`
- Preset-based configuration interface
- Real-time preview of export settings
- Progress monitoring with cancellation support
- Batch processing capabilities

**Caption Editor**: `src/renderer/components/CaptionEditor/index.tsx`
- SRT file parsing and manipulation
- Real-time caption styling preview
- Word-level timing adjustment
- Export-ready caption generation

### Feature Architecture

**Export Workflow State Machine**:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Pending
    Pending --> Running: Start Export
    Running --> Completed: Success
    Running --> Error: Failure
    Running --> Cancelled: User Cancel
    Completed --> [*]
    Error --> [*]
    Cancelled --> [*]
    
    note right of Running
        Progress updates
        Temporary files
        Cleanup on completion
    end note
```

**Speech Recognition Pipeline**:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Audio File] --> B[Whisper Worker]
    B --> C[Model Loading]
    C --> D[Transcription]
    D --> E[Progress Updates]
    E --> F[Structured Results]
    F --> G[SRT Generation]
    G --> H[Timeline Integration]
    
    style B fill:#FF6B6B
    style D fill:#4ECDC4
    style F fill:#45B7D1
```

The CapCut Killer project demonstrates a well-architected Electron application that successfully balances performance, usability, and feature richness. Its modular design allows for easy maintenance and future enhancements while providing a professional-grade video editing experience in a desktop environment.

**Sources:**
- [package.json](package.json)
- [index.ts](src/main/index.ts)
- [layout.tsx](src/renderer/app/layout.tsx)
- [main.tsx](src/renderer/app/main.tsx)
- [export.handler.ts](src/main/ipc/export.handler.ts)
- [ExportQueue.ts](src/main/services/ExportQueue.ts)
- [WhisperService.ts](src/main/services/WhisperService.ts)
- [page.tsx](src/renderer/app/page.tsx)
- [Timeline/index.tsx](src/renderer/components/Timeline/index.tsx)
- [useExport.ts](src/renderer/store/useExport.ts)
- [electron.vite.config.ts](electron.vite.config.ts)
- [tailwind.config.ts](tailwind.config.ts)
- [FFmpegService.ts](src/main/services/FFmpegService.ts)
- [whisper.worker.ts](src/main/workers/whisper.worker.ts)

</blog>
